mapper.sql: id, course_id AS courseId, title, body_html AS bodyHtml, author_user_id AS authorUserId, author_name AS authorName, posted_at AS postedAt, edited_at AS editedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, a.author_user_id AS authorUserId, a.author_name AS authorName, a.posted_at AS postedAt, a.edited_at AS editedAt, CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL OR a.author_user_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS `read` FROM course_announcement a INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id LEFT JOIN course_announcement_read r ON r.announcement_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE a.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY a.posted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.course_id AS courseId, c.course_code AS courseCode, a.title, a.author_user_id AS authorUserId, a.author_name AS authorName, a.posted_at AS postedAt, a.edited_at AS editedAt, CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL OR a.author_user_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS `read` FROM course_announcement a INNER JOIN enrollment e ON e.course_id = a.course_id AND e.user_id = #{userId} AND e.active = 1 INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = a.course_id INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN course_announcement_read r ON r.announcement_id = a.id AND r.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.tenant_id = u.tenant_id ORDER BY a.posted_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
